people.name: Marcus
observations: Jordan avoided facing Marcus after something happened the previous day, leading Jordan to call in sick.

people.name: Mikayla
observations: Ran into Jordan at Groundwork around noon while picking up coffee on her way to the gym.
Could tell Jordan had been in a funk but didn't push.
Sat with Jordan for 15 minutes and talked about nothing.
Sent Jordan a selfie from the gym after Jordan texted a thank-you.

projects.name: Coda project
observations: Jordan opened the Coda project at Groundwork and spent three hours working on it.
Built a practice-session timer with a visual metronome.
The metronome is a pulsing circle that expands and contracts at a set BPM.

places.name: Groundwork
observations: Jordan went to Groundwork around 10am intending to just get coffee and leave.
Jordan ended up spending three hours there working on the Coda project.
Ran into Mikayla there around noon.

places.name: apartment
observations: Jordan felt fog lift each time after leaving the apartment to go make something.
Jordan crawled into bed at 9pm the night before.
